name: Carousing
description: A week of carousing (downtime): spend silver by Tier (100, 500, 2,500 or 10,000 sp), make a Charisma check (DC 12), then roll a d20, adding 5 if the check succeeded (the Shopkeeper's Catalogue). The Carouse downtime plan rolls it for you.

results.name: Jailed after a brawl
results.description: Jailed after a brawl: pay the week's gold again as a fine, or spend 1d4 days in a cell.

results.name: Robbed in your sleep
results.description: Robbed in your sleep: lose half the coin you carry.

results.name: You wake up married, or engaged, to someone you barely...
results.description: You wake up married, or engaged, to someone you barely remember.

results.name: You insulted someone important
results.description: You insulted someone important. They remember, and so do their friends.

results.name: A dreadful hangover
results.description: A dreadful hangover: Disadvantage on checks and saves for 1 day.

results.name: You gambled away a non-magical item you own (the GM picks)
results.description: You gambled away a non-magical item you own (the GM picks).

results.name: You made a rival of about your Level, who wants a rematch
results.description: You made a rival of about your Level, who wants a rematch.

results.name: You signed something; the GM decides what you agreed to
results.description: You signed something; the GM decides what you agreed to.

results.name: You spent half again what you meant to
results.description: You spent half again what you meant to.

results.name: A quiet week
results.description: A quiet week. No effect.

results.name: You won at cards
results.description: You won at cards: gain back half the gold you spent.

results.name: You heard a rumour
results.description: You heard a rumour: the GM gives you one true lead.

results.name: A useful contact
results.description: A useful contact: someone in town owes you a favour.

results.name: You made a friend of a guard captain or official
results.description: You made a friend of a guard captain or official.

results.name: Someone offers you work worth twice what you spent
results.description: Someone offers you work worth twice what you spent.

results.name: A patron offers to fund one venture
results.description: A patron offers to fund one venture.

results.name: Your name gets about
results.description: Your name gets about: Advantage on Reaction Checks in this town for a month.

results.name: You won at dice
results.description: You won at dice: gain back the gold you spent.

results.name: A drunk sells you a map or a secret for a pittance, and...
results.description: A drunk sells you a map or a secret for a pittance, and it's real.

results.name: The talk of the town
results.description: The talk of the town: recover 1 Luck (once per character level), and a henchman offers to join you (see Hiring in the Codex).
